subject: Family Reunion Details
body: Dear Family Members, We are excited to announce the details for our upcoming family reunion! The event will take place on Saturday, July 24th at Green Park. Please RSVP by July 10th to confirm your attendance. The day will be filled with fun activities, games, and a delicious BBQ. We can't wait to catch up and create new memories together. Looking forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Your Name]
